verdict.rationale: Slack offers a broad Web API, Events API, CLI, and MCP server covering messaging, search, files, canvases, lists, and users (slack-docs-2/8/9/28/29/30/32), suggesting strong programmatic parity. However, community evidence shows real restrictions—Corporate Export requires legal approval before exporting DMs/private channels via API (slack-comm-2), and no evidence covers API-equivalents for UI-only features like Huddles or no-code Workflow Builder branching/triggers, so full UI-API parity is not substantiated.
